reasons: Sections 11.1-11.3 supply all three preferred elements: up to six months of transition assistance on expiry or termination for any reason, return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a commonly used, documented, machine-readable format, and secure deletion with written officer certification thereafter.

Terms are equal to or better than the playbook preferred position (rates fixed to the expiring Order Form rather than then-current rates; no withholding for fee disputes; retained legal-copy carve-out remains protected and use-restricted), so no redline is warranted.
Consistent with a compliant claim: no redline text changes and no counterparty comment were proposed, and the deterministic check confirms a data-return/transition clause is present.
No walk-away trigger (no immediate deletion on termination, no denial of data return) appears in the cited or adjacent sections.
